name: qBittorrent
description: qBittorrent is a BitTorrent client with a Web UI, packaged and maintained by LinuxServer.io.

paths.name: Config
paths.description: Persistent qBittorrent configuration, torrent state and session data.

paths.name: Downloads
paths.description: Torrent download directory. Change this host path to match your MOS storage layout.

variables.name: User ID
variables.description: UID used by the LinuxServer container for file ownership. MOS commonly uses UID 500.

variables.name: Group ID
variables.description: GID used by the LinuxServer container for file ownership. MOS commonly uses GID 500.

variables.name: UMASK
variables.description: Permission mask for files created by qBittorrent. 002 keeps files group-writable for shared MOS storage.

variables.name: Timezone
variables.description: Container timezone. Change this to your local timezone, for example Europe/Madrid.

variables.name: WebUI Port
variables.description: Internal qBittorrent Web UI port. Must match the mapped container port.

variables.name: Torrenting Port
variables.description: BitTorrent listening port. TCP and UDP container mappings must use the same port.
